messages:
Diego Park: Heads up — proposing a short go/no-go sync for the cut window. Draft: Tue 2026-04-07 09:30 PT (20m). Please reply with availability and minimal stake you need to be represented for (e.g., infra, canary, security). I sketched a mini-agenda below. Add yourself to attendance or flag conflicts. :calendar:

Asha Kapoor: 09:30 PT works for me. Security will join but might only be 10m.

Ben Liu: 09:30 is better than 10. I have a PR review at 10.

Elena Morris: I'm OOO that day until afternoon. Please record — I can drop a pre-read for the smoke checklist.

Matt Johnson: I can take the canary smoke bullet. Will prep a 2-slide checklist. Prefer 09:30 too.

Chris Infra: Tentative — depends on a capacity check I'll run Mon morning. If infra is needed live I might need call-in only for escalations.

Sarah O'Neill: FYI from product: we'll need a 3m rollout guardrail check (feature flags, metrics). I'll be there for that.

release-bot: Reminder: please RSVP in the calendar invite once Diego posts it. Auto-checklist: canary-doc, smoke-runner, rollback-playbook.

Diego Park: Thanks all — consensus leaning 09:30. Quick poll: who absolutely must be on the live call? Reply with one word role (e.g., security, infra, product, canary).

Asha Kapoor: security

Ben Liu: infra

Matt Johnson: canary

Sarah O'Neill: product

Elena Morris: pre-read (record)

Diego Park: OK — I'll move invite to Tue 09:30 PT and attach the agenda + pre-reads. Draft agenda (20m):
```
1) Rollcall & go/no-go criteria review (3m)
2) Canary smoke summary + results (5m)
3) Infra capacity / blocking issues (4m)
4) Security & compliance quick signoff (3m)
5) Rollout plan & rollback triggers (3m)
6) Action items / owners (2m)
```

Diego Park: If anyone wants to add a must-have agenda item, drop it here. Otherwise I'll send calendar invite and a short pre-read (canary checklist + kpi thresholds).

Chris Infra: Adding "DB migration lock window" as a potential blocker — may need 1m on the call.

Asha Kapoor: Adding "secrets rotation check" for security (1m).

Ben Liu: Confirming I'll run infra capacity probe Mon 08:00 PT and post results in the thread.

Diego Park: Perfect. If no objections by EOD Mon I'll finalize invite. Assigning owners: Matt = canary checklist, Ben = infra capacity, Asha = security signoff, Sarah = product guardrails, Elena = pre-read.

Sarah O'Neill: Sounds good. If the capacity probe shows issues, ping me immediately and we'll consider delaying cut by 24h.

Diego Park: Noted. Thanks everyone — I'll post the invite + attachments shortly. :thumbsup:
